TUT_WELCOME_DESC: Tjoean is an educational game that teaches financial literacy and investment through realistic simulation. You will manage your finances over 15 years and learn about various investment instruments available in Indonesia.
TUT_FUND_HINT: Your individual investment fund will be received each year. Allocate your funds wisely across different investment instruments.
TUT_EMERGENCY_DESC: Starting from the second year, emergency events will occur randomly each year. You will need between Rp 2,000,000 and Rp 4,500,000 to handle them.
TUT_PAY_CASH_DESC: Use your available cash on hand
TUT_OBJECTIVE_DESC: Maximize your total net worth over 15 years.
TUT_COMPARISON_DESC: Your final portfolio will be compared with the AI portfolio.
LABEL_INVESTMENTS_LONG: Investments (Stocks, Gold, Mutual Funds, Crypto, Crowdfunding)
DEPOSITO_EARLY_TOOLTIP: Early withdrawal penalty: 50% of accrued interest
DEPOSITO_ARO_COMPOUND_TOOLTIP: Automatically re-invest when matured with compound interest
MARKET_DEPOSITO_TIP: 💡 Fixed interest rate with guaranteed returns
MARKET_BOND_TIP: 💡 Low risk with monthly coupon payments
MARKET_STOCKS_TIP: 💡 Stock prices update every 2 months. Dividends paid annually. One stock on this list really failed — look for the High Risk tag!
MARKET_CRYPTO_WARNING: EXTREMELY RISKY! Can make huge gains or lose everything!
MARKET_CF_WARNING: Locked during investment period. 20% of projects may FAIL!
INTRO_CONGRATS: Congratulations {name}! You now have access to a new investment instrument!
EVENT_MARKET_PRICE_NOTE: ⚠️ Investment will be sold at current market price
EVENT_NO_SINGLE_SOURCE: 💡 No single source covers it? No worries — your investments can be sold automatically.
EVENT_EMERGENCY_LOAN_NOTE: If selling everything still isn't enough, the rest becomes an Emergency Loan at {monthly}% per month (about {annual}% a year). The game keeps going, but that debt is expensive!
DEBT_AUTO_REPAY_NOTE: The loan is repaid automatically from your cash and yearly salary until it's gone.
ARO_WHAT_IS_DESC: Automatic Roll Over (ARO) automatically re-invests your deposit when it matures. The maturity value (principal + interest) becomes the new principal for the next deposit with the same tenor.
ARO_BENEFITS_DESC:
• Compound interest - your earned interest also earns interest
• No need to manually re-invest
• Your money keeps working with zero downtime
ARO_GAME_RULES_DESC:
• When a deposit matures with ARO enabled, the full maturity value (principal + interest) is automatically re-invested
• The tenor and interest rate remain the same
• You can enable/disable ARO at any time
• Early withdrawal still incurs a 50% penalty on earned interest
ARO_REGULATION_DESC:
• ARO is a standard feature offered by nearly all banks in Indonesia
• Interest rates may change at renewal based on bank policy (in this game, rates stay the same)
• Deposits are guaranteed by LPS (Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation) up to Rp 2 billion per depositor per bank
• Deposit interest is subject to 20% final income tax
